data.standardized_narrative: No explicit gross prior-year movement for claims outstanding could be located in the available pages of the report. The opening gross claims outstanding (prior year comparative on the balance sheet liabilities) was identified. Narrative and movement notes quantifying gross prior year reserve development were not found or were not legible in the provided images.
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction limited by image quality and orientation. Opening gross claims outstanding obtained from the Balance Sheet (Technical provisions - Claims outstanding) prior-year comparative column (2013) on page 13. Could not find a clear, legible note showing the gross movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding (the required authoritative source). The Profit & Loss technical account contains 'claims incurred in prior underwriting years' rows (P&L line) which are not acceptable per instructions and were not used. No gross 'movement in prior year provision' table or gross claims development triangle was clearly readable; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. If a net prior-year movement is acceptable, that figure may exist in the P&L but was not used per rules. Many notes and numeric tables were illegible; confidence scores reflect this.
